review_candidates.title: Co-Founder
review_candidates.description: Founder & Executive Director VonGSTAAD — Remote | Brussels, Belgium About VonGSTAAD VonGSTAAD is being built as an independent research and institutional organisation focused on quantitative research, mathematical modelling, empirical investigation, data, computational systems, knowledge and institutional development. Our long-term architecture connects: Research → Data → Technology → Knowledge → Institution → Community → Commerce The objective is to build an organisation capable of producing rigorous research, developing durable intellectual and technical infrastructure, forming meaningful institutional relationships and transforming valuable research capabilities into sustainable activity. The Position VonGSTAAD is seeking a Founder & Executive Director to lead the organisation through its formation and long-term development. This is not a conventional management position. The Founder & Executive Director will establish the institutional direction of VonGSTAAD, coordinate its major functions and ensure that research, technology, knowledge, institutional development and commercial activity develop as parts of one coherent organisation. The role combines strategic leadership, institutional design, research governance, organisational development and long-term execution. Key Responsibilities - Define and protect VonGSTAAD's institutional mission and long-term direction. - Establish the organisation's research and institutional priorities. - Build the organisational structure required to execute those priorities. - Recruit and coordinate senior research, technical, knowledge, institutional and commercial leadership. - Establish standards for research quality, methodological integrity and documentation. - Ensure that research remains independent from commercial pressure. - Develop relationships with universities, research organisations, technology companies and other institutions. - Guide the development of VonGSTAAD's data and computational infrastructure. - Oversee the transformation of research capabilities into institutional programmes and sustainable business activity. - Establish appropriate governance, processes and accountability. - Represent VonGSTAAD with senior external stakeholders. - Allocate organisational resources according to strategic priorities. - Develop the next generation of researchers, engineers and institutional professionals. - Build an organisation capable of operating beyond the founder's direct involvement. What We Are Looking For We are looking for an individual capable of building an institution, not simply managing a company. You should combine strategic vision with intellectual discipline and practical execution. The ideal candidate can move comfortably between: - Research and strategy - Mathematics and empirical reasoning - Technology and data - Institutional relationships - Organisational design - Commercial development - Communication and leadership You do not need to be the deepest technical specialist in every discipline. You must, however, be able to understand specialists, challenge weak reasoning, make difficult decisions and create an environment in which excellent specialists can work effectively. Leadership Principles VonGSTAAD is intended to be built around several principles: Rigour over appearance. Claims must be supported by evidence. Research before promotion. Communication must not outrun the underlying work. Reproducibility over opacity. Important work should be documented and traceable. Long-term institution over short-term activity. The objective is to build durable capabilities. Intellectual independence. Commercial interests must not dictate research conclusions. Execution with accountability. Ideas matter only when they can be developed into functioning systems, programmes or outputs. What Kind of Person We Want We are looking for someone who thinks in systems and time horizons. Someone who can ask: What should this organisation become? What capabilities must exist for that to happen? Which people should build them? What standards must govern them? What should VonGSTAAD refuse to do? How does today's decision affect the institution five or ten years from now? The Founder & Executive Director must be comfortable with uncertainty while remaining rigorous about what is known, what is assumed and what remains to be demonstrated. Organisational Architecture The organisation is being developed through seven connected functions: RESEARCH Quantitative research, methodology and scientific investigation. DATA Data architecture, engineering, integrity and research datasets. TECHNOLOGY Research software, computational infrastructure and systems. KNOWLEDGE Research editing, documentation and institutional knowledge. INSTITUTION Partnerships, programmes and external institutional relationships. COMMUNITY Researchers, contributors, professionals and structured programmes. COMMERCE Business development, client solutions and sustainable institutional activity. The Founder & Executive Director provides the strategic coherence connecting these functions. Development Opportunity This position offers the opportunity to shape an organisation from an early stage rather than inherit an established structure. The successful candidate will have substantial influence over: - Institutional strategy - Organisational design - Research priorities - Leadership recruitment - Governance - Partnerships - Technology development - Commercial strategy - Long-term institutional positioning The role is therefore suited to someone motivated by building something durable, rather than simply occupying an executive title. Working Model Remote position VonGSTAAD's institutional base is Brussels, Belgium. The role requires significant independence, strong written and verbal communication, disciplined decision-making and the ability to work across multiple functions. Why VonGSTAAD? VonGSTAAD is being built at the intersection of research, technology and institution-building. The opportunity is to help establish the foundations of an organisation whose ambition extends beyond individual projects: a durable platform for research, knowledge, technical capability, institutional collaboration and sustainable development. If you are interested in building an institution from its foundations—and believe that intellectual ambition must be matched by methodological discipline and execution—we would like to hear from you. Website: VonGSTAAD.com

review_candidates.title: Aircraft Technician - Line Maintenance Support
review_candidates.description: Job Purpose At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through, our global hub in Dubai; and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers ‘Fly Better’. Emirates Engineering is a cutting-edge aircraft maintenance facility, GCAA CAR V approved, supporting Emirates’ vast Airbus and Boeing fleet and thirty other airlines through third-party contracts. Our highly qualified team excels in maintenance, engineering, quality, planning, and logistics, setting industry standards with an unwavering commitment to safety and excellence. As an Aircraft Technician in Line Maintenance Support you will be responsible for carrying out maintenance tasks on Emirates and third party aircraft components in accordance with company procedures and regulations. The Aircraft Technician works as part of a team under the direction and guidance of the assigned Licensed Aircraft Engineer within the appropriate trade/cross trade disciplines for which they have been trained In This Role You Will Carry out routine aircraft/engine/component servicing/ maintenance and/or approved structural repairs compliant to manufacturers procedures whilst observing all safety procedures for fluid replenishment, aircraft refuelling, aircraft systems charging/servicing as required. Complete any component replacement and other maintenance activities as directed by immediate Supervisor. This will include the ability to obtain and understand Aircraft Maintenance Manual (AMM), Illustrated Parts catalogue (IPC), Component Maintenance Manual (CMM) or other approved documentation required to carry out the task. Assist Licensed Aircraft Engineers in trouble shooting, defect rectifications and carrying out modifications while also performing instructions contained in job card. Participate and promote in creating a safety culture in an effort to minimise accidents and highlight any deficiencies/failures that can lead to such accidents. Ensure all work locations are kept clean and maintain excellent housekeeping. This includes being aware and communicating safety shortfalls. Maintain vigilance in ensuring work areas (including the ramp), vehicles, stands, lockers are free of FOD and that toolboxes are regularly audited, maintained and kept clean. Responsible to maintain knowledge of airport safety regulations including holding and maintaining an Airport Driving Permit. Should be fully conversant and compliant with airport manoeuvring area requirements. Be responsible for managing performance by working closely with supervisor on performance management processes, using MyBC system to agree on development plans including training and development requirements. Ensure prompt attendance to all allocated tasks with the intent to maximise ground time and avoid operational delays/disruptions. This includes obtaining aircraft/component status brief from Licensed Aircraft Engineer (LAE), reports and preparing work accordingly. Communicate any aircraft/ component/ structural defects to the LAE in a timely manner and ensure relevant information is during shift handovers. As and when required, use current knowledge and experience in aircraft maintenance to assist in Resource allocation using RMS / RTC. Qualification Experience Engineering: 5+ Years Qualifications Graduate (12+2) Knowledge/skills Apprenticeship in Aircraft Maintenance or equivalent training with a reputable airline or an approved aircraft maintenance organisation or Engineering Aircraft Maintenance License. Salary & benefits Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotels stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers
